title: Developer
description: For people who build things: WSL, chezmoi, PowerShell modules and command-line tools, on top of the power profile. WSL needs a restart and virtualization turned on in the PC's firmware.

apps.name: chezmoi
apps.why: Keeps the person's own config files (dotfiles) in a repo.

apps.name: fzf
apps.why: Fuzzy finder for the command line.

wsl.afterSetup: After the restart and the first Ubuntu sign-in, copy profiles/wsl/.bashrc.deskside to ~/.bashrc.deskside and add the source line it shows to ~/.bashrc.
